responsibility: Provides the Darwin-specific D frontend target hook implementation. It supplies D builtin version identifiers for Darwin/OSX/Posix, registers __traits(getTargetInfo, "objectFormat") to report Mach-O, and defines the Darwin D runtime module-info section names and start/end symbols used for emitted ModuleInfo data. This file is the D-language companion to generic Darwin target support, not the core Mach-O backend itself.
